clinician.trajectory_summary: Patient presented with classic clinical features of onychomatricoma: ingrowth at the inner corner, transverse over-curvature of the nail plate, ungual hyperkeratosis, and xanthonychia (longitudinal yellowish stripe). Physical examination documented these characteristic nail abnormalities (E001, E002). MRI imaging (T2-weighted) revealed fingerlike projections located on the lateral portion of the nail matrix (E003), which is the pathognomonic imaging finding for onychomatricoma. The clinical presentation combined with the characteristic MRI findings of matrix projections established the diagnosis of onychomatricoma, a benign tumor of the nail matrix.
